title: 二分割の街路樹グレーチング
description: 中央の樹幹開口、放射状スリット、同心円補強帯を備える二分割鋳鉄グレーチング。樹木は含みません。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。
descriptionEn: A two-piece cast-iron tree grate with central trunk opening, radial slots and concentric reinforcement; no tree included. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
